note: Chile: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days (Australia since 17 September 2025), 60 (Indonesia, a single entry) or 30 days (Belize, Macao, Malaysia, Singapore); Venezuelans and Haitians need a visa, and Kosovo's passports aren't recognised. Everyone else needs a visa (Chinese holding a Canadian or US visa may enter: not modelled). The Cook Islands' and Niue's 90 days are New Zealand's here. Read on 2026-11-03 from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own table of visas by nationality (the data behind consulado.gob.cl's page), which corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on Belize (30 days, not 90) and Indonesia (60, not 30).

sources.said: La permanencia transitoria es el permiso otorgado por el Servicio Nacional de Migraciones a los extranjeros que ingresan al país sin intenciones de establecerse en él y que los autoriza a permanecer en territorio nacional por un periodo de hasta 90 días.
